note: the graded episode's service (graded_service.py): public constants only; the hidden mission is episode.json and its site package, which only the worker reads (as root). cell_config.json is a byte copy of tests/grader_config.json (the grader's run settings of the cell); cell_manifest.json pins every file of the cell (tests/plantcell, which setup.sh copies from the image's practice ground) and of the privileged reference program (tests/reference, byte copy in reference/). env is the grader's numerics and rendering environment (tests/test.sh's exports: thread counts, the OpenBLAS and numpy pins, the render bundle). prep_s = main's agent budget ([agent] timeout_sec 14400 on main): the episode must be started within it, and the program freezes at its end at the latest; graded_s = the window from the start to the episode's latest end. practice_flag (O13): the start writes it; the practice ground ends its missions and refuses new ones once it exists. The freeze (DM3): snapshot_max_bytes null = tests/grader_config.json's route_gate.max_submission_mb (60 MB, main's cap); entries and depth bounded so the copy finishes and stays within the engine's artifact limits.
